integrity.computational_limit: Finite verification is corroborative, not proof for arbitrary lengths or amplitudes.

scientific_limitations: Only nonnegative valley-shaped data (or arbitrary data with valley-shaped modulus) on finite unweighted paths; does not settle the unrestricted sharp variational conjecture. Shape of the output is valley-shaped without a specified location of its minimum. Older unindexed work may contain equivalent facts.
title: Sharp centered maximal variation for valley profiles on finite paths
